|ingredients = {{Name|Cave Carrot|1}}{{Name|Winter Root|1}} }} '''Roots Platter''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients. Roots Platter may randomly appear in the [[Volcano Dungeon#Shop|Volcano Dungeon shop]] or [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. 5 Roots Platter may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |love=Penny |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Tailoring== Roots Platter is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt117.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Roots Platter is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].
